news.title: KEC: Strong New Orders And Global T And D Wins Will Support Upside
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for KEC International from ₹793.10 to ₹776.85, reflecting a slightly higher discount rate and a subtly lower assumed future P/E multiple in their updated view. What's in the News Secured new orders of ₹25,180 million across multiple businesses, including its largest-ever commercial real estate order from a developer in Western India, received in the normal course of business (Key Developments).

news.title: KEC: New Order Wins And Backlog Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have reduced their fair value estimate for KEC International to about ₹793 from roughly ₹805, reflecting small adjustments to assumptions on discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E multiples. What's in the News New orders of about ₹25,180 million secured across businesses, including the largest Commercial Real Estate order from a developer in Western India, a joint venture order in the Train Collision Avoidance System segment under Kavach, and multiple T&D projects and supply contracts across Africa, Europe, the Americas and India (Key Developments) Additional new orders of about ₹14,760 million booked for T&D projects in India, the Middle East, Africa and the Americas, including 380 kV lines, substations and EHV cabling in Saudi Arabia, 132 kV lines in Africa

news.title: KEC: New Transmission Orders And Backlog Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have modestly trimmed their fair value estimate for KEC International, revising the price target from ₹829 to about ₹804, as they fine tune assumptions around the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E. What's in the News New orders of ₹14,760 million secured for Transmission & Distribution projects across India, the Middle East, Africa and the Americas, including 380 kV lines, substations and EHV cabling in Saudi Arabia, 132 kV lines in Africa and tower, hardware and pole supplies in India and the Americas (Key Developments).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.79 (down from ₹4.87 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹60.0b (up 12% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.27b (down 1.6% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 2.1% (down from 2.4% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 3.3%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 41%. Revenue is forecast to grow 14% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Construction industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 46% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 13% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
